meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据代码结构（而非文本）搜索和改写代码，支持 25 种编程语言。例如，找到所有特定形状的函数、调用或类，或将 console.log 替换为 logger.info。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找或改写代码结构（如函数、类、导入语句）时触发。对于文本内容（如字符串、注释）则使用 grep。

say.text: 找到所有空 catch 块。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search and rewrite code based on structure (not text) across 25 languages. For example, find all functions/calls/classes of a certain shape, or replace console.log with logger.info.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to find or rewrite code structure (e.g., functions, classes, imports). For text content (strings, comments), grep is used instead.

say_en.text: Replace all console.log with logger.info in the project.
